verdict.rationale: Whether user data is used for AI training is a fair privacy question for a hosted email service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training policy, an opt-out, or a no-training commitment. The community remark that Fastmail is 'up front with how the data is handled' is general privacy sentiment, not evidence of this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
